messages:
lina: pushed fixes for the rate-limiter PR — moved config parsing into init, added unit test, cleaned up logs. PTAL when you have a sec? https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/412

samir: quick q — did you run the CI perf job on the new allocator changes? curious about p95 changes.

lina: yep ran the perf job, numbers look stable: p50 ~2.1ms, p95 stayed ~9.8ms. pasted the tiny sample output below:
```
perf_summary: {"p50":2.1, "p95":9.8, "throughput":1200} 
```
CI run: https://ci.internal.redwood/runs/12345

vik: skimmed the diff — lgtm overall. prefer a squash commit for history. i'll approve after squash. also need one more approval from maria before merging. :thumbsup:

maria: i can take a look in ~1h and add my 👍 or small nits.

ci-bot: Build passed · All checks green (unit, integration, e2e).

samir: left a tiny inline suggestion about keeping the error context key consistent (non-blocking for functionality, but helpful for debugging).

lina: addressed samir's suggestion and pushed a follow-up commit (sha: abc1234). updated the PR with the squash plan and changed the proposed canary window to tomorrow 11:00–12:00 PDT to match ops availability. PTAL @vik @maria

vik: reviewed the new commit, looks good. approved. will merge during the 11:00–12:00 window if CI stays green.

maria: quick docstring nit, not a blocker. if you squash it in the commit message, feel free to merge.

lina: thanks all — i'll squash + merge at 11:10 if nothing flakes. tagging ops to monitor the canary: @ops-team

ops-bot: Canary watch scheduled for runtime PR #412 at 2026-03-19T18:10:00Z. Notifications will be posted to #incidents if any regressions detected.
